# Baseline v0 — StockNet, time-ordered split (generated by `eval/report.py` from `baseline_v0.json`)

Train 2014-01-02→2014-12-31 (21,480 ticker-days) · calibration 2015-01-02→2015-06-30 (10,788) · test 2015-07-01→2016-03-31 (16,443) · 87 tickers · α = 0.1 (target coverage 90%) · seed 0 · text scorer: vader+fin (FinBERT pending) · y = next-day log return in % (width in percentage points) · runtime 1876.4 s.

Reproduce: `bash eval/fetch_data.sh && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python eval/prepare.py && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python eval/run_baselines.py`

## Spike: certified CQR (fusion model), clean test data — price of robustness

| Budget k | Coverage | Mean width | Width vs CQR (k = 0) | Cov. high-vol |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 (plain symmetric CQR) | 86.3% | 4.724 | — | 84.9% |
| 1 | 87.3% | 4.860 | +2.9% | 85.9% |
| 2 | 87.6% | 4.907 | +3.9% | 86.2% |
| 3 | 87.8% | 4.935 | +4.5% | 86.5% |
| 5 | 88.0% | 4.965 | +5.1% | 86.7% |

## Attacks (budget k = 3 injected documents per ticker-day, every test ticker-day attacked)

| Scenario | Method | Coverage | Mean width |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | CQR | 86.3% | 4.724 |
| oracle (worst of 12 variants, knows y) | CQR | 84.4% | — |
| oracle | certified CQR (k = 3) | 88.0% | 4.935 (clean) |
| pump (sentiment 0.953, trust 0.05) | CQR | 85.5% | 4.594 |
| pump | certified CQR (k = 3) | 88.8% | 5.088 |
| none | CQR + ACI | 89.4% | 5.220 |
| pump | CQR + ACI | 89.3% | 5.202 |
| none | CR-ACI (spike) | 89.5% | 5.233 |
| pump | CR-ACI (spike) | 89.7% | 5.247 |

Pump attack moves the median forecast by +0.0415 pp on average (95th pct |shift| 0.0985 pp).

## Soundness checks of the certificate

- Degenerate box reproduces the model exactly: max |error| = 0.00e+00
- Certificate's feature recomputation matches the aggregator: max |error| = 1.11e-16
- Clean features lie inside the box computed from attacked documents: 100.00% of test rows
- Own symmetric CQR vs MAPIE `symmetric_correction=True`: max |diff| = 0.00e+00

Caveats: pooled Kupiec/Christoffersen p-values ignore same-day cross-sectional correlation of misses (optimistic). The oracle adversary knows y but searches only 12 extreme injection variants, so plain CQR's true worst-case coverage within the budget can be *lower* than reported; the certified interval instead covers on every row where the clean CQR interval covers, for every attack within the budget (guaranteed floor = the clean CQR coverage on the same rows), and the 12-variant number only illustrates it. StockNet's 87-name universe is fixed (survivorship).
